statement: Classic Maya observers recorded recurring lunar phenomena and the synodic orbit of Venus without optical instruments, demonstrating sustained naked-eye astronomical observation embedded in calendrical practice.

sources.citation: John H. Linden, “Glyph X of the Maya Lunar Series: An Eighteen-Month Lunar Synodic Calendar,” American Antiquity (2017).
sources.author: John H. Linden

sources.citation: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian, Living Maya Time, “Maya Sun.”
sources.author: Smithsonian NMAI
sources.venue: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian

notes: This does not imply that every Classic Maya astronomical claim or ritual interpretation was empirically correct.
